title: windows-smoke CI job's path-sensitive CLI list is hardcoded
body:
The windows-smoke job runs three hardcoded path-sensitive CLI test files (doctor_cli, record_playtest_session_cli, qa_triage_cli — .github/workflows/ci.yml:~179). New path-sensitive CLI suites do not join automatically, so the lane that exists because "a repo-root bug made health red on Windows and stayed green in CI" can silently under-cover as bin/ grows.

Options: derive the list (a filename convention like *_cli.test.ts under tests/unit, or a small marker the workflow globs), or pin the list with a regression test that fails when a new *_cli test file exists but is absent from ci.yml, so additions become a conscious choice. The second is cheaper and matches the repo's pin-the-contract style.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P3.

evidence.summary: 2026-08-30 audit: the lane built for a shipped blind spot under-covers as CLI surface grows
